request.report:
Applied the advisor's three final documentation corrections (no rerun needed — all measurements and artifacts were already complete):

1. bench/m1-notes.md §7: fixed mem0-r0 step0 agent count from 11 → 10 reqs to match recon/inventory.json (verified requests=10).
2. bench/m1-notes.md §1: clarified the --spec-type ngram-family descriptions are inferred from flag names, not sourced from help.txt (help.txt lists values only).
3. bench/m1-notes.md §9 + site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md: disclosed the B-setting upstream warning "ngram_mod n_match=12 is too small - poor quality is possible" (llama.cpp PR #19164), noted B was a cost comparison on a known-degraded setting, not a recommendation.

The no-deploy decision is unchanged and still supported (live bonsai-2-27b entry unchanged). All artifacts (off/A/B greedy + off/A prod, 4 phases each) exist under bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/replay/.
request.summary: M1 complete. Replay implemented in bench/spec_replay.py; measurements + server logs + VRAM in bench/results/2026-10-12/m1-ngram/replay/{off-greedy,A-greedy,B-greedy,off-prod,A-prod}/ (each with 4 phases: requests.jsonl, vram.txt, server_*.log). Covers agent (30 reqs) + mem0 (12 reqs) at 1 and 2 busy slots, greedy + production sampling, draft acceptance, output hashes. Both n-gram settings failed the two-slot speed rule (default ngram-mod slower on both production two-slot foreground roles: agent 26.7 vs 31.3 tok/s, mem 23.4 vs 25.4); speculation changed outputs and caused length-capped loops. No live config changed. Advisor's final doc fixes applied: mem0-r0 step0 = 10 agent reqs (bench/m1-notes.md §7); §1 descriptions marked inferred not help-sourced; B n_match=12 warning disclosed in bench/m1-notes.md §9 and site/series/serving/ngram-self-speculation.md.
